newsitem.title: MOLDOVA: AILING MOLDOVA FOREIGN MINISTER IS NEW PARIS ENVOY.
newsitem.headline: AILING MOLDOVA FOREIGN MINISTER IS NEW PARIS ENVOY.

text.p: Moldovan President Petru Lucinschi on Friday relieved Foreign Minister Mihai Popov of his duties on health grounds and appointed him the former Soviet republic's first ambassador to France.

Lucinschi, who announced the news in a conversation with reporters, did not name any immediate replacement for the 48-year-old minister, who has undergone several surgical operations in the last two years.
Popov is expected to start his new job with the inauguration of Moldova's Paris embassy ahead of a state visit to France which Lucinschi plans to make on September 7-9.
